name: kookr-toolkit
description: Curated skills and review subagents for AI-assisted development. Code patterns (TypeScript, async, error handling, DI, DDD), workflow (TDD, git commit hygiene, token efficiency), OSS contribution (PR critic, reviewer distillation, fork manager), and 15 review subagents (boundary-critic, design-minimalist, failure-mode-analyst, etc.) used by Kookr for iterative RFC review and pre-PR quality gates.
